gloss: on bad terms; not getting along

definitions.gloss: on bad terms; not getting along
definitions.explanation: Describes a relationship where two or more people do not get along well, whether due to conflict, personality clashes, or long-standing friction.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い。
⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}かった。
examples.english: Even though they're siblings, they haven't gotten along since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}くて、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}する→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧。
examples.english: We're on bad terms with the neighboring department, and opinions clash at every meeting.

notes:
The opposite of ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (to be on good terms). ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧ refers to the quality of a relationship between people. This expression is used for any kind of interpersonal friction — between individuals, groups, organizations, or even countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲|なか}が{悪|わる}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become estranged
- {仲|なか}が{悪|わる}そう: they seem to not get along
- ⟦{犬猿|けんえん}の{仲|なか}→犬猿の仲：18789_kenennonaka⟧: like cats and dogs (lit. dog-monkey relationship)

USAGE:
Can be used for both temporary conflicts and deep-seated animosity. The degree of the bad relationship depends on context. In formal contexts, ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧ or ⟦{折|お}り{合|あ}い→折り合い：09144_oriai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ may be preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不仲|ふなか}→不仲：15745_funaka⟧: discord, estrangement — a noun form meaning the same thing, slightly more formal
- ⟦{険悪|けんあく}→険悪：20010_kenaku⟧: hostile, strained — describes a more seriously deteriorated atmosphere
- ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: on good terms — the direct antonym
